answer: Each epoch the node samples 4% of identities and re-runs their work, and one upheld challenge revokes standing outright. At that rate a fake survives 25 epochs on average, so a farm of 1,000 pays 25 epochs of overhead before the first opal is clawed back, and the reef it hits is not the sample size but the ridge of public revocations that follows, which makes every later registration cost more to vouch.
